app.name: Salat
app.tagline: Learn the prayer, word by word
learn.title: The prayer, step by step
learn.subtitle: %d steps — read them in your own words, then in Arabic
practice.title: Passive review
practice.hint: Let it run. Each step stays long enough to sink in.
settings.widget.title: Home screen widget
settings.widget.hint: Add the Salat widget to your home screen: touch and hold the wallpaper, tap +, then search for Salat. It cycles through the positions on its own.
settings.disclaimer: This app follows the practice agreed upon by the four Sunni schools. Where they differ, the difference is noted rather than settled. It is a memorisation aid, not a substitute for a teacher.
onboarding.1.title: Welcome
onboarding.1.body: Salat teaches you what to say during the prayer — in Arabic, spelled out the way you read, and translated into your language.
onboarding.2.title: Step by step
onboarding.2.body: Fourteen steps, from the intention to the closing greeting. Open one and you get the posture, the Arabic, the pronunciation and the meaning.
onboarding.3.title: Then you get asked
onboarding.3.body: The Memorise tab turns the steps you have read into short rounds of questions: which line comes next, which word is missing, which words go with a position.
onboarding.4.title: Even on your home screen
onboarding.4.body: Add the widget and a position comes back to you throughout the day, without opening anything.
onboarding.5.title: You're ready
onboarding.5.body: Take your time. One step a day is already a lot.
audio.title: Recitation
audio.none: No recitation was recorded for this step — record yourself and check against the pronunciation above.
audio.none.listen: No recitation was recorded for this step: follow the written pronunciation above.
audio.mine.title: My recitation
audio.denied: The microphone is switched off for Salat. Turn it on in iOS Settings to record yourself.
audio.compare.hint: Both traces share one time axis: you can see where you go faster, where you stop. It shows the shape, not whether it is right — for that, an ear.
settings.audio.credits: Recitations of Al-Fatiha and Al-Ikhlas from everyayah.com. The rest of the prayer is not Qur'an and has no such recording — those steps carry no reciter.
settings.audio.adhkar: The adhkar of the prayer (istiftah, tasbih, tashahhud…) are read from Hisn al-Muslim, via hisnmuslim.com, and the isti'adha by the reciters themselves.
settings.audio.timing: Word-by-word timing from the quran-align project (Collin Fair, CC BY 4.0).
revise.subtitle: Pick a way to work. More tools will land here.
revise.tool.vocal.title: Voice practice
revise.tool.vocal.body: Listen to a reciter, record yourself, put the two side by side.
revise.gallery.subtitle: Pick a step to work on.
vocal.tap_hint: Tap a line to work on it.
settings.reminders.hint: One notification a day, naming a step you have not learned yet. Nothing is sent while the app is open, and it stops on its own after two silent weeks.
settings.reminders.denied: Notifications are switched off for Salat. Turn them on in iOS Settings to be reminded.
notif.title: Salat
notif.body.1: %@ is still waiting for you. Two minutes is enough.
notif.body.3: Pick up where you left off: %@.
notif.body.done: You have learned all fourteen steps. Go through them once so they stay.
onboarding.language.title: Your language
onboarding.language.body: We took the one your phone is set to. Change it here if you would rather read another; Settings can change it again at any time.
analytics.title: My progress
analytics.subtitle: The days you worked on it, what you hold, and what is still waiting.
analytics.calendar.title: Your study days
analytics.calendar.hint: One square per day over the last thirteen weeks. A square fills as soon as you open a step.
analytics.due.title: Go back to this
analytics.due.hint: Started, then left aside the longest — first. This is what the daily reminder names.
analytics.due.empty: Nothing waiting. Everything has been seen recently.
analytics.learned.title: What you have learned
analytics.learned.empty: Nothing marked as known yet. Open a step and say where you stand.
analytics.timeline.title: These last days
analytics.timeline.empty: Your history starts the first time you open a step.
notif.body.learning: %@ is still in progress. Two minutes are enough.
notif.body.review: Go over %@ once so it stays.
memorize.ready: steps read so far. A round asks eight questions about them.
memorize.strength.title: What comes back
revise.tool.drill.title: Exercises
revise.tool.drill.body: Eight questions built from the steps you have read.
drill.q.posture: Which words go with this position?
drill.done.title: Round finished
drill.done.score: %d right out of %d. What you missed comes back first next time.
drill.empty: Nothing to ask yet. Open a step in Learn and say where you stand with it: the exercises are built from what you have already read.
revise.tool.flash.title: Flashcards
revise.tool.flash.body: Read the meaning, say the words, flip the card to check.
revise.tool.fade.title: Fading recitation
revise.tool.fade.body: The words vanish a few at a time, until you carry the line yourself.
revise.tool.widget.title: Home screen widget
revise.tool.widget.body: See how it works, choose what it shows.
widget.how.title: How it works
widget.how.body: The widget changes step on its own, about once a minute. It follows what you are learning, and after you open a step it stays on it for a few minutes.
widget.show.title: What it shows
widget.focus.title: Text shown first
flash.done.title: Deck finished
flash.done.body: Every card left on “I knew it”. The ones you missed came back until they stuck.
fade.hint: Recite each line aloud, then hide a little more. At the last rung, nothing is left to read.
drill.picker.subtitle: Pick the exercise you want to work — nothing is imposed. Filter by step to stay on one passage.
drill.picker.mixed.title: Mixed round
drill.picker.mixed.body: Eight exercises dealt across everything you have read, weakest first.
guide.title: Add the widget
guide.step1: Touch and hold an empty spot on your Home Screen.
guide.step2: Tap Edit in the top left corner, then Add Widget.
guide.step3: Search for Salat, pick a size, then add the widget.
quran.offline: No connection: the recitation can't play.
settings.quran.text: Qur'an text from the Tanzil project (tanzil.net). The recitation of each verse is downloaded from everyayah.com when it plays.
premium.title: Salat Premium
premium.pitch: All of Learn Salah, for the minutes you used to scroll.
premium.benefit.widget: The widget on your Home Screen and Lock Screen
premium.benefit.quran: The Qur'an to read and listen to, verse by verse
premium.legal: %@ per month, renewed automatically until you cancel. Cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period in your App Store account settings.
premium.active.body: All of Learn Salah is open. Thank you for your support.
premium.unavailable: The App Store can't be reached right now.
premium.notice.none: No subscription was found on this Apple account.
premium.notice.pending: The purchase is waiting for approval.
premium.notice.failed: The purchase did not go through. Please try again.
widget.locked.body: Open Salat to unlock the widget
widget.quran.title: My excerpts
widget.quran.empty: No excerpt yet. Pick a surah or a suggestion.
widget.quran.how: The widget shows your verses one after another, about one a minute.
quran.notes.title: My notes
quran.notes.hint: Write what this verse says to you. Your notes stay on this iPhone, nobody else reads them.
quran.saved.title: My verses
quran.saved.empty: Like a verse or write a note on it: you will find it here.
welcome.scroll.title: Stop scrolling. Recite instead.
welcome.scroll.body: Turn the minutes you lose in your feed into time with the Qur'an and your prayer.
welcome.hours.title: How many hours a day on your phone?
welcome.hours.body: A rough guess is enough. Your answer stays on this iPhone.
welcome.reckoning.title: That's about %d days a year
welcome.reckoning.none.title: Where do your minutes go?
welcome.reckoning.body: Whole days in front of a screen. Ten minutes of them, every day, are enough to change something.
welcome.reckoning.swap: 10 min a day = over 60 hours a year with the Qur'an
welcome.words.title: Learn what you say in prayer
welcome.words.body: The Arabic, how to say it and what it means, line by line, with a reciter's voice.
welcome.steps.title: One step at a time
welcome.steps.body: Fourteen steps, from the intention to the final salam, at your own pace.
welcome.widget.title: Your Home Screen, before the feed
welcome.widget.body: The widget shows a verse or a step of the prayer. Reach for your phone, and that's the first thing you see.
welcome.commit.title: Pick your daily moment
welcome.commit.body: Each day at this time, a gentle reminder: a few minutes with the Qur'an instead of the feed.
premium.pitch.hours: About %d h a day on your phone, you said. Give a few minutes of them to the Qur'an.
premium.benefit.prayer: The whole prayer, step by step, with audio
premium.benefit.revise: Quizzes and cards to learn it by heart
premium.benefit.reminders: A daily reminder at the time you choose
premium.legal.trial: Free for %d days, then %@ per month, renewed automatically until you cancel. Cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends and you won't be charged. Manage it in your App Store account settings.
